title: capsella bursa-pastoris var. agrestis
intro: Capsella bursa-pastoris var. agrestis, commonly known as shepherd's purse, is a plant in the Brassicaceae family that has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of shepherd's purse include its ability to reduce inflammation, aid in wound healing, and help to alleviate symptoms of menopause such as hot flashes. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, diuretic, and uterine stimulant, making it useful for treating conditions like menstrual cramps and excessive bleeding. The bioactive constituents of shepherd's purse include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
